question: Apply WGCNA to cluster multi-omics features and identify modules associated with disease phenotype (the 'Disease' column in Pheno.csv). Combine RNA and protein data by row-binding (rbind) into a single expression matrix. Use blockwiseModules with TOMType='unsigned', deepSplit=4, minModuleSize=10, mergeCutHeight=0.3; select softPower via pickSoftThreshold (powerVector=1:10, default to 6 if powerEstimate is NA). Correlate each module eigengene with the Disease trait using Pearson correlation, and report  p-values via corPvalueStudent

expected_output.guidelines: If the same number of modules as reference is identified: each module's Correlation and Pvalue must match the reference within +/-0.05; module name/color labels, column order, and header labels may differ. If the number of modules differs from reference: compare the top-5 modules ranked by absolute correlation — at least 3 of the top-5 must appear in the reference's top-5 (matched by correlation sign and approximate magnitude within +/-0.1); the overall Spearman rank correlation of all module correlations must be >= 0.6.
Heatmap must show module-trait correlations as a color grid with correlation values overlaid; axis labels, color scale, and font styling may differ.
